@.about-hero-subtitle: Community-driven DSH plugin index · Minimal, Open, Community-driven
@!#what-is-dsh .section-paragraph:nth-of: DSH (DeepSeek Harness, dsh) is an open-source agent harness developed by DeepSeek AI, built on an "everything is a plugin" architecture driven by Cordis. It is in developer preview and iterating fast. With Node.js installed, run npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web to start the Web UI (defaults to http://127.0.0.1:3080).

Plugins are the only way DSH gains new capabilities — vision, dashboards, environment bridges, workflow integrations and more all ship as plugins. DSH-Registry is a community-driven index of DSH plugins, automatically aggregating open-source DSH plugins from GitHub so developers can discover, browse and install them. There is no database and no backend: the data layer is a public Git repository — every index change is an auditable, revertable commit.
The crawler scans GitHub every 6 hours for repositories with the dsh-plugin topic; you can also open a PR against config/seeds.json to get indexed directly.
@#features .feature-card:nth-child(2) .f: A three-level trust badge (Unreviewed / Community-Vouched / Flagged) with fully public criteria — risk at a glance.
@#features .feature-card:nth-child(3) .f: The index lives entirely in a public Git repository; every change is a commit: diffable, revertable, community-auditable, and a clone away from disaster recovery.

@!#how-to-submit .section-paragraph:nth-: Want your DSH plugin indexed? Option 1 (recommended): open an issue — the "Submit" link in the nav leads straight to the submission form; just fill in the repository address. No fork required. Once the owner reviews and adds it to the seeds, the next crawl (≤6 hours) picks it up. Note: indexing is not auditing — indexing only adds the plugin to the index; its state remains "Unreviewed".
@#how-to-submit .submit-step:nth-child(1: Click "Submit" in the nav to go straight to the issue form.
@!#how-to-submit .submit-step:nth-child(: In the form owner/name; confirm dsh.bundle.patch is declared, README and LICENSE exist, then submit the issue.
@#how-to-submit .submit-step:nth-child(3: Once the owner merges it into the seeds, the server's next sync (≤6 hours) regenerates the index and the plugin goes live, marked "Unreviewed".
@!#how-to-submit .section-paragraph:nth-: Option 2 (passive): add the dsh-plugin topic to your GitHub repository and (recommended) declare dsh.registry metadata in package.json; the crawler discovers qualifying repositories on its 6-hour scan.

@#contributing .section-paragraph:nth-of: DSH-Registry is a fully open-source community project. Every contribution is welcome — new plugins, bug fixes, documentation, or simply your ideas.
